text: dsh-session-doctor 是 DeepSeek Harness 的会话日志诊断插件，另提供命令行工具。DSH bundle 注册 session_doctor 工具，扫描本地 JSONL 会话代次，并按读取器的 turn、step 和事件作用域规则查找异常。报告可指出无效行、会话头缺失、嵌套或顺序错误、步号和作用域问题，并列出事件序号与类型。默认检查每个会话的最高代次，也可检查所有保留代次。适合排查本地会话日志读取问题；扫描只读，可指定会话目录，默认从 DSH_HOME 或 ~/.dsh 查找。

dsh-session-doctor scans local Harness JSONL sessions for reader-rule problems. Its DSH tool and CLI report malformed rows and event locations. It checks the latest generation or retained generations on request. Scanning is read-only and supports a custom sessions directory or DSH_HOME.
想查出哪些本地 DSH 会话日志事件会让读取器无法打开会话。
帮我扫描会话文件，指出 turn 或 step 的顺序哪里不对。
I need a read-only report of malformed local DSH session log events and their sequence numbers.
dsh-session-doctor 的功能「读取器规则诊断」：扫描本地会话日志并检查 turn、step 和事件作用域。通过 DSH 工具或 CLI 启动，可指定目录并获得异常序号、类型和说明；扫描不改写文件。

dsh-session-doctor README · dsh-session-doctor：Read-only diagnostics for **DeepSeek Harness** (`dsh`) session logs whose stored events violate the reader's
turn/step/scope rules. This is the failure class behind Discussions
[#11971](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/11971),
[#11981](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/11981), and
[#11121](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/11121) (adjacent lifecycle issues):
one bad event coordinate makes a whole stored session unloadable, and the harness reports it as a corrupt session
with no way to inspect which signature caused it.

dsh-session-doctor README · dsh-session-doctor：`session-doctor` decodes each canonical `session.vN.jsonl[.zstd]` generation, replays the rules the current reader
enforces, and names the exact sequence number, event type, and expectation that no longer holds. It never writes to a
session file.

dsh-session-doctor README · What it checks：It is a **signature detector aligned with the current V4 reader**, not a full format validator: it does not re-implement
message payload validation, migrations, or compression framing beyond zstd.

dsh-session-doctor README · Install：From npm (pre-release tag while the plugin is young):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-doctor@next
```

From the Git repository (runs the package `prepare` build):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/aturzone/dsh-session-doctor.git
```

dsh-session-doctor README · Use as a dsh bundle：The bundle inserts one plugin row; the plugin registers the model-facing `session_doctor` tool, which scans
`$DSH_HOME/sessions` (or a `sessionsRoot` argument) and returns the same report as the CLI. Read-only.
dsh-session-doctor README · Development overlay (from a checkout)：```yaml

dsh-session-doctor README · overlay.yml：- insert:
    - id: session-doctor-dev
      name: /absolute/path/to/dsh-session-doctor/src/index.ts
```

```sh
pnpm dsh web --patch ./overlay.yml
```

dsh-session-doctor README · Use as a CLI：```sh
session-doctor [--home <DSH_HOME>] [--sessions-root <dir>] [--json] [--all-generations]
```

dsh-session-doctor README · Example output：```text
session root: /home/me/.dsh/sessions
sessions: 12 scanned, 1 with reader-incompatible signatures

✗ --home-me-project--/session-8bc9…

dsh-session-doctor README · Limitations：- Only the highest canonical generation per session directory is scanned unless `--all-generations` is passed;
  retained predecessors are otherwise invisible by design.
- No repair or quarantine yet. The tool names the defect; moving a corrupt generation aside stays a manual decision.
- The rules mirror the V4 reader at the time of release. A future format version needs this project updated in step
  with `session-format-vN-to-vN+1`.

dsh-session-doctor README · Development：```sh
pnpm exec vitest run --root .
```

Node ≥ 24.9 (uses `node:zlib` zstd). MIT.
